verdict.rationale: The pack documents a REST API, SDKs, an MCP server whose tools load automatically, and an llms.txt docs index. None of it shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec for the API. llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation indexes, not API specifications, and runtime MCP tool discovery is an adjacent feature, not a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
